signal: Trainual acquired Uptick in October 2025 and shipped major onboarding upgrades like training path templates.

email.body1:
Jared, saw Trainual acquired Uptick and shipped the new onboarding path templates.

Moves like that usually mean more partner and co-sell targets in play than the team can activate before things ramp, so partner-sourced pipeline lags. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across a partner ecosystem, so co-sell coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Trainual's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jared, quick follow-up for Trainual.

Partner-sourced pipeline usually stalls not on strategy but on follow-up: too many co-sell targets and partner contacts to work consistently by hand. That is where partner revenue quietly leaks.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of Trainual's top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them, plus how the worker keeps co-sell follow-up warm at scale?
email.body3:
Jared, last bit of proof for Trainual.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Trainual's partner reply rate likely compares to peer SaaS programs. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jared, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition and running partnerships is plenty to juggle.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a co-sell motion? I will tailor it to Trainual either way.
